on_monthly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = { spec_monthly }
}

spec_monthly = {
	effect = {
		# leaving the market economy switches the system off and clears it; coming back starts fresh
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { spec_law_mult > 0 }
				OR = { has_variable = spec_conf has_modifier = spec_panic_relief }
			}
			spec_shut_down = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { spec_law_mult > 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = spec_conf } }
				set_variable = { name = spec_conf value = 55 }
				set_variable = { name = spec_stance value = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = spec_debt } }
				set_variable = { name = spec_debt value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = spec_c_boom value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_c_crash value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_c_tight value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_c_foreign value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_c_world value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_credit_given value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_n_boom value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_n_end_1 value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_n_end_2 value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_n_end_3 value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = spec_c_restrain value = 0 }
			remove_variable = spec_crash_top
			set_variable = { name = spec_fd value = spec_fd_levels }
			set_variable = { name = spec_mh value = spec_mh_levels }
			set_variable = { name = spec_mv_total value = spec_market_value }
			set_variable = { name = spec_hm value = spec_hype_mult }
			set_variable = { name = spec_hmd value = spec_hype_mult_down }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						AND = {
							has_variable = spec_word_aeroplanes
							var:spec_word_aeroplanes = 0
							has_variable = spec_hprev_aeroplanes
							NOT = { has_variable = spec_glut_aeroplanes }
							NOT = { has_variable = spec_restrain_aeroplanes }
							NOT = { has_variable = spec_encourage_aeroplanes }
							var:spec_sev_aeroplanes = 0
							var:spec_fast_aeroplanes > -0.001 var:spec_fast_aeroplanes < 0.001
							var:spec_slow_aeroplanes > -0.001 var:spec_slow_aeroplanes < 0.001
							var:spec_hype_aeroplanes > 0.999 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 1.001
							var:spec_hprev_aeroplanes > 0.999 var:spec_hprev_aeroplanes < 1.001
							var:spec_peak_aeroplanes < 1.01
							spec_mv_aeroplanes = 0
							spec_dev_aeroplanes = 0
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = spec_fast_aeroplanes } }
					set_variable = { name = spec_fast_aeroplanes value = spec_dev_aeroplanes }
					set_variable = { name = spec_slow_aeroplanes value = spec_dev_aeroplanes }
					set_variable = { name = spec_peak_aeroplanes value = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = spec_fast_aeroplanes value = spec_fast_next_aeroplanes }
				set_variable = { name = spec_slow_aeroplanes value = spec_slow_next_aeroplanes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = spec_hype_aeroplanes }
					set_variable = { name = spec_hprev_aeroplanes value = var:spec_hype_aeroplanes }
				}
				set_variable = { name = spec_hype_aeroplanes value = spec_hype_next_aeroplanes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = spec_restrain_aeroplanes }
					change_variable = { name = spec_c_restrain subtract = spec_restrain_cost_aeroplanes }
				}
				set_variable = { name = spec_peak_aeroplanes value = spec_peak_next_aeroplanes }
				if = {
					limit = { var:spec_hype_aeroplanes >= 3 }
					change_variable = { name = spec_c_boom add = { value = spec_weight_aeroplanes multiply = 0.85 } }
					set_variable = { name = spec_cb_aeroplanes value = { value = spec_weight_aeroplanes multiply = 0.85 } }
					change_variable = { name = spec_n_boom add = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = spec_sev_aeroplanes value = spec_sev_next_aeroplanes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = spec_encourage_aeroplanes var:spec_sev_aeroplanes >= 2 }
					remove_variable = spec_encourage_aeroplanes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:spec_sev_aeroplanes = 3
						var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 0.167
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = spec_rr value = spec_risk_raw_aeroplanes }
					change_variable = { name = spec_c_crash subtract = local_var:spec_rr }
					set_variable = { name = spec_cc_aeroplanes value = local_var:spec_rr days = 28 }
					if = {
						limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = spec_crash_top } local_var:spec_rr > var:spec_crash_top } }
						set_variable = { name = spec_crashed value = g:aeroplanes }
						set_variable = { name = spec_crash_top value = local_var:spec_rr days = 28 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { any_company = { OR = { is_company_type = company_type:company_basic_motors is_company_type = company_type:company_fcm is_company_type = company_type:company_fiat is_company_type = company_type:company_ford_motor is_company_type = company_type:company_hispano_suiza is_company_type = company_type:company_manfred_weiss } } }
						if = {
							limit = { has_modifier = spec_company_bust_aeroplanes }
							remove_modifier = spec_company_bust_aeroplanes
						}
						add_modifier = {
							name = spec_company_bust_aeroplanes
							days = 365
							multiplier = spec_company_tie
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333
							NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_command_economy }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cooperative_ownership }
							every_scope_state = {
								limit = {
									any_scope_building = {
										OR = { is_building_type = building_automotive_industry }
										level >= 3
									}
								}
								add_radicals_in_state = { value = very_large_radicals strata = lower }
							}
							if = {
								limit = { is_player = yes }
								set_variable = { name = spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes value = 1 days = 28 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							every_scope_state = {
								limit = {
									any_scope_building = {
										OR = { is_building_type = building_automotive_industry }
										level >= 3
									}
								}
								add_radicals_in_state = { value = very_large_radicals strata = upper }
								add_radicals_in_state = { value = large_radicals strata = middle }
							}
							if = {
								limit = { is_player = yes }
								set_variable = { name = spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes value = 3 days = 28 }
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_centre_trust spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333 }
						set_variable = { name = spec_centre_trust value = { value = var:spec_centre_trust subtract = { value = 18 multiply = spec_exch_loss } min = 0 } }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes }
							set_variable = { name = spec_centre_trust value = { value = var:spec_centre_trust subtract = { value = 18 multiply = spec_exch_loss } min = 0 } }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes }
						remove_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes
						remove_variable = spec_issue
						set_variable = { name = spec_issue_cool value = 1 days = 365 }
						spec_update_levers = yes
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_glut_aeroplanes value = 3 days = 360 }
					set_variable = { name = spec_ui_crash_aeroplanes value = 3 days = 28 }
					if = {
						limit = { is_player = yes spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333 }
						g:aeroplanes = { save_scope_as = spec_note_good }
						set_variable = { name = spec_note_bank_aeroplanes value = spec_exp_mult_aeroplanes days = 28 }
						set_variable = { name = spec_note_over_aeroplanes value = spec_over_mult_aeroplanes days = 28 }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_bank value = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_bank_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_bank value = var:spec_note_bank_aeroplanes }
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_over value = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_over_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_over value = var:spec_note_over_aeroplanes }
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_ppl value = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_ppl value = var:spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_bank > 1.04 scope:spec_note_over > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_3_bank_over
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_bank > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_3_bank
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_over > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_3_over
						}
						else = {
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_3_plain
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_peak_aeroplanes value = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_exp_aeroplanes }
						change_variable = { name = spec_exp_aeroplanes multiply = 0.5 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_sev_aeroplanes value = 0 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						var:spec_sev_aeroplanes = 2
						var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 0.5
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = spec_rr value = spec_risk_raw_aeroplanes }
					change_variable = { name = spec_c_crash subtract = local_var:spec_rr }
					set_variable = { name = spec_cc_aeroplanes value = local_var:spec_rr days = 28 }
					if = {
						limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = spec_crash_top } local_var:spec_rr > var:spec_crash_top } }
						set_variable = { name = spec_crashed value = g:aeroplanes }
						set_variable = { name = spec_crash_top value = local_var:spec_rr days = 28 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_company = { OR = { is_company_type = company_type:company_basic_motors is_company_type = company_type:company_fcm is_company_type = company_type:company_fiat is_company_type = company_type:company_ford_motor is_company_type = company_type:company_hispano_suiza is_company_type = company_type:company_manfred_weiss } }
							NOT = { has_modifier = spec_company_bust_aeroplanes }
						}
						add_modifier = {
							name = spec_company_bust_aeroplanes
							days = 180
							multiplier = spec_company_tie_2
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333
							NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_command_economy }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cooperative_ownership }
							every_scope_state = {
								limit = {
									any_scope_building = {
										OR = { is_building_type = building_automotive_industry }
										level >= 3
									}
								}
								add_radicals_in_state = { value = large_radicals strata = lower }
							}
							if = {
								limit = { is_player = yes }
								set_variable = { name = spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes value = 1 days = 28 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							every_scope_state = {
								limit = {
									any_scope_building = {
										OR = { is_building_type = building_automotive_industry }
										level >= 3
									}
								}
								add_radicals_in_state = { value = large_radicals strata = upper }
								if = {
									limit = { owner = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_laissez_faire } }
									add_radicals_in_state = { value = small_radicals strata = middle }
								}
							}
							if = {
								limit = { is_player = yes }
								set_variable = { name = spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes value = 2 days = 28 }
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_centre_trust spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333 }
						set_variable = { name = spec_centre_trust value = { value = var:spec_centre_trust subtract = { value = 6 multiply = spec_exch_loss } min = 0 } }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes }
							set_variable = { name = spec_centre_trust value = { value = var:spec_centre_trust subtract = { value = 6 multiply = spec_exch_loss } min = 0 } }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes }
						remove_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes
						remove_variable = spec_issue
						set_variable = { name = spec_issue_cool value = 1 days = 365 }
						spec_update_levers = yes
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_glut_aeroplanes value = 2 days = 180 }
					set_variable = { name = spec_ui_crash_aeroplanes value = 2 days = 28 }
					if = {
						limit = { is_player = yes spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333 }
						g:aeroplanes = { save_scope_as = spec_note_good }
						set_variable = { name = spec_note_bank_aeroplanes value = spec_exp_mult_aeroplanes days = 28 }
						set_variable = { name = spec_note_over_aeroplanes value = spec_over_mult_aeroplanes days = 28 }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_bank value = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_bank_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_bank value = var:spec_note_bank_aeroplanes }
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_over value = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_over_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_over value = var:spec_note_over_aeroplanes }
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_ppl value = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_ppl value = var:spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_bank > 1.04 scope:spec_note_over > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_2_bank_over
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_bank > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_2_bank
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_over > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_2_over
						}
						else = {
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_2_plain
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_peak_aeroplanes value = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_exp_aeroplanes }
						change_variable = { name = spec_exp_aeroplanes multiply = 0.5 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_sev_aeroplanes value = 0 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						var:spec_sev_aeroplanes = 1
						var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 0.5
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = spec_rr value = spec_risk_raw_aeroplanes }
					change_variable = { name = spec_c_crash subtract = local_var:spec_rr }
					set_variable = { name = spec_cc_aeroplanes value = local_var:spec_rr days = 28 }
					if = {
						limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = spec_crash_top } local_var:spec_rr > var:spec_crash_top } }
						set_variable = { name = spec_crashed value = g:aeroplanes }
						set_variable = { name = spec_crash_top value = local_var:spec_rr days = 28 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_company = { OR = { is_company_type = company_type:company_basic_motors is_company_type = company_type:company_fcm is_company_type = company_type:company_fiat is_company_type = company_type:company_ford_motor is_company_type = company_type:company_hispano_suiza is_company_type = company_type:company_manfred_weiss } }
							NOT = { has_modifier = spec_company_bust_aeroplanes }
						}
						add_modifier = {
							name = spec_company_bust_aeroplanes
							days = 90
							multiplier = spec_company_tie_1
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_centre_trust spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333 }
						set_variable = { name = spec_centre_trust value = { value = var:spec_centre_trust add = 2 max = 120 } }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes }
							set_variable = { name = spec_centre_trust value = { value = var:spec_centre_trust add = 2 max = 120 } }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes }
						remove_variable = spec_issue_aeroplanes
						remove_variable = spec_issue
						set_variable = { name = spec_issue_cool value = 1 days = 365 }
						spec_update_levers = yes
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_glut_aeroplanes value = 1 days = 90 }
					set_variable = { name = spec_ui_crash_aeroplanes value = 1 days = 28 }
					if = {
						limit = { is_player = yes spec_weight_aeroplanes >= 0.333 }
						g:aeroplanes = { save_scope_as = spec_note_good }
						set_variable = { name = spec_note_bank_aeroplanes value = spec_exp_mult_aeroplanes days = 28 }
						set_variable = { name = spec_note_over_aeroplanes value = spec_over_mult_aeroplanes days = 28 }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_bank value = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_bank_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_bank value = var:spec_note_bank_aeroplanes }
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_over value = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_over_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_over value = var:spec_note_over_aeroplanes }
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_ppl value = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes }
							save_scope_value_as = { name = spec_note_ppl value = var:spec_note_ppl_aeroplanes }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_bank > 1.04 scope:spec_note_over > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_1_bank_over
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_bank > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_1_bank
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:spec_note_over > 1.04 }
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_1_over
						}
						else = {
							post_notification = spec_boom_end_1_plain
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_peak_aeroplanes value = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = spec_exp_aeroplanes }
						change_variable = { name = spec_exp_aeroplanes multiply = 0.5 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = spec_sev_aeroplanes value = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:spec_sev_aeroplanes >= 1 NOT = { has_variable = spec_sup_aeroplanes } }
					set_variable = { name = spec_sup_aeroplanes value = spec_mv_aeroplanes }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:spec_sev_aeroplanes = 0 has_variable = spec_sup_aeroplanes }
					remove_variable = spec_sup_aeroplanes
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = spec_wold value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = spec_word_aeroplanes }
					set_local_variable = { name = spec_wold value = var:spec_word_aeroplanes }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { spec_mv_aeroplanes > 0 }
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable = spec_word_aeroplanes
							var:spec_word_aeroplanes > 0
						}
						if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes < 6 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes >= 6.24 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 6 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes < 5 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes >= 3.12 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 5 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes < 4 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes >= 2.08 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 4 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes < 3 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes >= 0.5208 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 3 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes < 2 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes >= 0.174 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes > 1 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 0.1606 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 1 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes > 2 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 0.4808 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 2 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes > 3 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 1.92 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 3 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes > 4 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 2.88 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 4 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { var:spec_word_aeroplanes > 5 var:spec_hype_aeroplanes < 5.76 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 5 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { var:spec_hype_aeroplanes >= 6 }
							set_variable = { name = spec_word_aeroplanes value = 6 }
						}

					set_variable = { name = spec_low2 value = g:wine }
					set_variable = { name = spec_low2_v value = var:spec_hype_wine }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:spec_hype_wood > var:spec_top1_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top3 value = var:spec_top2 }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top3_v value = var:spec_top2_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top2 value = var:spec_top1 }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top2_v value = var:spec_top1_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top1 value = g:wood }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top1_v value = var:spec_hype_wood }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:spec_hype_wood > var:spec_top2_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top3 value = var:spec_top2 }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top3_v value = var:spec_top2_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top2 value = g:wood }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top2_v value = var:spec_hype_wood }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:spec_hype_wood > var:spec_top3_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top3 value = g:wood }
					set_variable = { name = spec_top3_v value = var:spec_hype_wood }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:spec_hype_wood < var:spec_low1_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_low2 value = var:spec_low1 }
					set_variable = { name = spec_low2_v value = var:spec_low1_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_low1 value = g:wood }
					set_variable = { name = spec_low1_v value = var:spec_hype_wood }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:spec_hype_wood < var:spec_low2_v }
					set_variable = { name = spec_low2 value = g:wood }
					set_variable = { name = spec_low2_v value = var:spec_hype_wood }
				}
				spec_find_risk_src = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
